author: Imago Dei Church
title: An East Bay church is building a community to combat modern loneliness
text:
13 hours ago In the bustling community of Castro Valley, where the demands of modern life often overshadow personal connections, Imago Dei Church stands as a beacon of hope and companionship. Michael Chung, the planting pastor behind this welcoming spiritual haven, has crafted a church that aims to fill the void of isolation that many feel today. Nestled amidst the everyday hustle, Imago Dei Church offers a space where individuals can find not only spiritual solace but also a deep sense of community. Through its unique approach to worship and community engagement, the church has become a vital part of the local landscape, inviting both skeptics and believers to explore their faith and foster meaningful relationships.
The inception of Imago Dei Church is deeply rooted in Michael Chung’s desire to address a pervasive issue he observed in society: loneliness. Founded in response to the growing epidemic of isolation, the church opened its doors with the mission to create a place where people could find connection and purpose. Michael reflects on the inspiration behind the church's creation, stating, "When people ask why I planted a church, the answer is simple: I kept meeting people who were lonely. Not lonely in the way we usually picture it, but lonely in the modern way—busy at work and each night, but known by almost no one." This realization led Michael to envision a community that could offer more than just spiritual guidance, but also a sense of belonging and meaning. Since its establishment, Imago Dei Church has sought to provide a sanctuary where individuals can come together, share their stories, and support one another through life’s ups and downs.
What sets Imago Dei Church apart from other places of worship is its distinct focus on gospel preaching and the message it delivers. Central to its mission is the proclamation of the gospel, which Michael describes as "good news"—an announcement rather than advice. "It's not 'here are ten steps to become a better person,' but 'God has done for you what you could never do for yourself,'" he explains. This approach is reflected in the church’s Sunday services, where the Bible is explained in modern terms, allowing its stories and teachings to resonate deeply with contemporary life. By engaging both skeptics and lifelong believers, the church creates an inclusive environment where all are welcome to explore their faith at their own pace. The church's name, ‘Imago Dei,’ meaning ‘image of God,’ embodies its commitment to recognizing the inherent dignity and worth of every individual, ensuring that everyone who walks through its doors feels valued and embraced.
Michael Chung’s journey with Imago Dei Church is filled with moments of profound connection and discovery. One of his favorite aspects of his role is meeting with individuals and delving into their personal narratives. "Each person has deep layers: histories, wounds, hopes," he shares, emphasizing the privilege of being invited into the depths of people’s lives. This openness to personal stories aligns with the church’s mission to explore and celebrate the inherent value in every person. Michael’s passion for pastoral ministry is evident in the joy he derives from these encounters, stating, "My greatest joy is discovering and exploring that truth, one conversation at a time." These interactions not only reinforce the church’s mission of love and dignity but also highlight the transformative power of community. Through these shared stories, Imago Dei Church continues to foster a sense of belonging and support, creating a space where individuals can be truly known and appreciated.
Looking ahead, Michael Chung envisions Imago Dei Church as a continually evolving community that deepens its impact on the lives of its members and the wider Castro Valley area. His aspirations for the church extend beyond its current offerings, aiming to further strengthen the bonds of community and faith. Michael hopes to see Imago Dei Church become a model of what a truly connected community can look like, where love for God and for neighbors is lived out in tangible ways. By continuing to prioritize gospel preaching and personal connections, he aims to inspire more people to find meaning and purpose through their faith. As the church grows, Michael remains committed to nurturing an environment where every individual is valued and can experience the transformative power of being part of a supportive and loving community.
